sources.title: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model; v1 60s ice-surface global grid
sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

access_metadata.resolution: 60 arc-seconds (downsampled by NOAA from 15s); approx 1853m at equator
access_metadata.vertical_datum: EPSG:3855 EGM2008; elevations in metres; surface of Greenland/Antarctic ice sheets
access_metadata.polar_coverage: Full global grid. Last three derivative rows per pole are longitude-invariant; not a historical ice reconstruction.
access_metadata.known_gaps: NOAA declares no nodata cells in source grid. Composite observations, spatially variable accuracy, current ice/engineering and lake bathymetry cannot reconstruct 1900.
access_metadata.ocean_handling: Negative elevations clipped to zero before derivation; no bathymetry, shoreline, land owner or water identity created. Below-sea-level land depressions also suppressed.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: PHYSICAL_REFERENCE: broad mountain/plateau/plain forms only; not 1900 precise surface, ice, coast, settlement, land use, roads or population.
access_metadata.uncertainty: Runtime region sampling about 9.8km north-south and longitude-dependent east-west; World about 39.1km. Not usable for slope/path/combat queries.
access_metadata.data_transformation: Area box average DEM to 4096x2048; nonnegative elevation; periodic longitude Gaussian sigma .65; metric derivatives; two fixed lights and 6x visual slope exaggeration; log-height tint; R8 signed modulation; 1024x512 box-average LOD; no runtime elevation. Runtime RG8: red signed form, green quantized log-positive-height for unowned background only; no elevation values or ownership. Physical background is not a historical coastline.

value.representation: Two finite static global RG8 LODs; shared source fact, no terrain simulation
